title: A simple bead-based method for generating cost-effective co-barcoded sequence reads
protocol: Pellet up to 1 × 10^7 dispersed nucleated cells at 500xg for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the cell pellet.
Add 500 μL of lysis buffer to the cell pellet and vortex briefly on medium speed for 3-5 seconds.
Place the conical tube containing the lysed cells in a refrigerator for approximately 10 minutes, swirling occasionally.
Prepare proteinase K solution by combining 250 μL of 10% SDS with 250 μL of Proteinase K and 4 mL of 1X TE.
Warm the prepared proteinase K solution on a 50 °C heat block for about 5 minutes.
Prepare the digestion solution by mixing 20 μL of RNase-It ribonuclease cocktail with 4 mL of digestion buffer.
Add approximately 4 mL of the digestion solution to the lysed cells and buffer from step one, then gently rock the conical tube.
Place the conical tube in a 50 °C heat block for 5 minutes, then add 4.5 mL of the warmed proteinase K solution to the free-floating pellet.
Gently swirl the conical tube to mix the contents thoroughly.
Recap the tube and incubate it in a 50 °C heat block for 2 hours, swirling gently every 30 minutes.
Cut approximately 13 cm of dialysis tubing.
Allow the dialysis tubing to equilibrate in 0.5X TE for 30 minutes.
Seal one end of the dialysis tubing with a dialysis clip.
Pour at least 1 L of 0.5X TE buffer into a dialysis reservoir.
Carefully pour viscous genomic DNA from the conical tube into the open end of dialysis tubing.
Seal the open end of dialysis tubing with a dialysis clip.
Attach a float to one clip and place the dialysis tubing with float into the dialysis reservoir.
Dialyze the genomic DNA at room temperature for 24 to 48 hours while stirring the buffer gently with a magnetic stir bar.
Replace the TE buffer once during the dialysis period to maximize the purity of the recovered DNA.
Upon completion of dialysis, remove the dialysis tubing from the TE buffer.
Remove the float and clip from the top of the dialysis tubing.
Gently pour the contents into a 15 mL conical tube.
Mix 10 μL of complementary oligonucleotide from each well of the source 384-well plates in 384-well PCR plates with 10 μL 3X Annealing Buffer.
Incubate at 70°C for 3 minutes followed by a slow ramp of 0.1°C/s to 20°C on a PCR thermocycler.

Mix 4.725 mL (157.5 μmol) of hybridized Bead Linker containing a 5’ dual-biotin with 3.225 mL of Ligation Buffer (10X), 460.8 μL (921,600 units) of T4 DNA Ligase, and 9.67 mL dH2O to a total volume of 18.081 mL.
Dispense 11.2 μL of the ligation mixture into each well of four new 384-well PCR plates.
Add 8.8 μL (580 pmol) from each well of the hybridized first barcode plates to each well containing the bead linker ligation mixture.
Seal with MicroAmp Clear Adhesive Film.
Vortex the mixed solution.
Centrifuge the mixed solution.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Collect 100 billion (143 mL) of M-280 streptavidin coated magnetic beads by transferring 50 mL into an empty 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Place the tube with beads in the Easy 50 EasySep™ Magnet for 5 minutes to collect beads.
Carefully remove supernatant by pipette.
Transfer a second 50 mL of beads into the tube on magnet and let sit for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant carefully after 5 minutes.
Transfer a final 43 mL of beads to the 50 mL tube and let sit for 5 minutes on magnet.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Wash beads twice with Low-Salt Wash Buffer.
Resuspend well in 8 mL of High-Salt Bead Binding Buffer.
Dispense 5 μL of beads in High-Salt Bead Binding Buffer to each well containing ligation product.
Vortex the beads source tube occasionally during dispensing to keep beads suspended.
Seal plates with MicroAmp Clear Adhesive Film.
Vortex plates and place onto the tube revolver for incubation at room temperature for 1 hour on “oscillating” mode.
Centrifuge plates at 300 x g for 5 seconds to remove beads from seal but not allow a pellet to form.
Remove seal and add 2.8 μL of 0.1% SDS to each well.
Seal plates again with MicroAmp Clear Adhesive Film.
Vortex briefly and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Vortex plates.
Centrifuge plates at 300 x g for 5 seconds.
Remove the seal from each plate and invert plates onto a collection tray.
Centrifuge plates at 500 x g for 2 minutes.
Collect beads into one new 50 mL tube using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Place tubes on an Easy 50 EasySep™ Magnet for 5 minutes to collect beads.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash collected beads once with 10 mL of High Salt Wash Buffer.
Wash collected beads twice with Low-Salt Wash Buffer.
Resuspend beads in 8 mL of 1XLigation Buffer.
Dispense 5 μL of resuspended beads into each well of four new 384-well PCR plates.
Vortex the beads source tube occasionally during dispensing to keep the beads suspended.
Mix Ligation Buffer, T4 DNA Ligase, and dH2O to a total volume of 10.02 mL for ligation mixture.
Dispense 6.2 μL of the second ligation mixture to each well in the four 384-well PCR plates containing beads.
Add 8.8 μL from each well of hybridized second barcode plates to corresponding wells in the PCR plates with bead and ligation mixture.
Repeat steps 18-22.
Mix 3.225 mL Ligation Buffer (10X) with 460.8 μL T4 DNA Ligase and 6.33 mL dH2O to a total volume of 10.02 mL.
Dispense 6.2 μL of the ligation mixture into each well of four 384-well PCR plates containing beads.
Add 8.8 μL from each well of hybridized third barcode plates to corresponding wells in the 384-well PCR plates.
Repeat steps 18-22.
Store the beads at 4 °C for up to one year.
Count the beads with a hemocytometer and take out 5 million beads for the QC step.
Place the tube with beads onto the DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 5 μL 100% formamide, 4 μL dH2O, and 1 μL 10X loading buffer.
Incubate it at 95 °C for 3 minutes on a PCR thermocycler.
Immediately place on ice for 2 minutes.
Place the tube with beads onto the DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 5 minutes.
Collect the supernatant, load it on a 15% TBU gel, and run at 200 V for 40 minutes to check the oligo length and amount.
Pipette 500 million constructed barcoded beads from step 26 of the previous section into a standard 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of a 1X dilution of Buffer D.
Vortex briefly and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat steps adding Buffer D and collecting beads one more time.
Wash once in 1X Annealing buffer.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant.
Mix 36 μL of 100 μM Bridge Oligo, 333.33 μL of Annealing Buffer (3X), and 630.67 μL of dH2O for a final volume of 1 mL.
Add mixture to beads.
Vortex briefly.
Incubate at 60 °C for 5 minutes.
Incubate at room temperature for 50 minutes.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend in 500 μL of Low-Salt Wash Buffer.
Hybridize the capture transposon oligos by combining 10 μL of Transposon1T (100 μM), 10 μL of TransposonB (100 μM), and 10 μL of Annealing Buffer (3X) in the first well of an 8-well PCR strip tube.

Hybridize the non-captured transposon oligos by combining 10 μL of Transposon1T (100 μM), 10 μL of TransposonB (100 μM), and 10 μL of Annealing Buffer (3X) in the second well of the same PCR strip tube.
Incubate at 70 °C for 3 minutes followed by a slow ramp of 0.1 °C/s to 20 °C on a PCR thermocycler.
Combine the two transposons into the third well of the PCR strip tube.
Couple the Tn5 enzyme to the transposon mix by combining 9.6 μL of mixed transposons with 23.53 μL of Tn5 (13.6 pmol/μL) and 46.87 μL of Coupling Buffer (1X).
Incubate the solution at 30 °C for 1 hour.
Use immediately or store at -20 °C for up to 1 month.
Make aliquots prior to storage for optimal performance and consistency between experiments.
Combine 12 μL of Transposase Buffer (5X), 0.5 μL of coupled transposon, and 40 ng of DNA in a total volume of 60 μL in one well of an 8-well strip tube.
Incubate the mixture at 55 °C for 10 minutes.
Transfer 40 μL of transposon incorporated material to one well of a new 8-well strip tube.
Add 4 μL of 1% SDS to the transferred material.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Load the material from step 43 on a 0.5X TBE 1% agarose gel.
Run the gel at 150 V for 40 minutes.
Dilute 1.5 μL of the remaining product of step 42 with 248.5 μL of 1x Hybridization buffer.
Transfer 50 μL of beads from step 36 to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Place the tube on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 250 μL of Hybridization Buffer (1X).
Heat DNA separately at 60 °C for 30 seconds.
Heat beads separately at 60 °C for 30 seconds.
Add 250 μL of diluted DNA to the 250 μL of beads.
Mix gently by flicking the bottom of the tube with a finger.
Incubate at 60 °C for 10 minutes, mixing every few minutes.
Place the tube on revolver for incubation in oven at 45 °C for 50 minutes on “oscillating” mode.
Make ligation mix by combining 100 μL of Ligation Buffer, No MgCl2 (10X), 2 μL of T4 DNA ligase (2x106 units/mL), and 398 μL of dH2O.
Incubate on tube revolver for 1 hour on “oscillating” mode at room temperature.
Add 110 μL of 1% SDS to tube and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant and wash once with 500 μL of Low-Salt Wash Buffer and once with 500 μL of NEB2 buffer (1X).
Make capture oligo digestion mix by combining 10 μL of NEB2 buffer (10X), 2 μL of UDG (5,000 U/mL), 3 μL of APE1 (10,000 U/mL), 2 μL of Exonuclease 1 (20,000 units/mL), and 83 μL of dH2O.
Remove wash buffer and add digestion mix to beads.
Vortex lightly to resuspend beads and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant and wash once with 500 μL of Low-Salt Wash Buffer and once with 500 μL of PfuCx Buffer (1X).
Prepare PCR master mix by adding 150 μL of PCR mix (2X), 4 μL of PCR Primer 1 (100 μM), 4 μL of PCR primer 2 (100 μM), 6 μL of PfuCx enzyme, and 136 μL of dH2O.
Preheat the PCR mastermix at 95 °C for 3 minutes.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove wash buffer and add PCR master mix to beads.
Vortex lightly to resuspend beads.
Cycle PCR reaction with the following conditions: 72 °C for 10 minutes.
Cycle PCR reaction with the following conditions: 95 °C for 10 seconds.
Cycle PCR reaction with the following conditions: 58 °C for 30 seconds.
Cycle PCR reaction with the following conditions: 72 °C for 2 minutes.
Repeat steps 2-4 of the cycle 10-12 times.
Hybridize the capture transposon oligos by combining 10 μL of Transposon1T (100 μM), 10 μL of TransposonB (100 μM), and 10 μL of Annealing Buffer (3X) in the first well of an 8 well PCR strip tube.
Hybridize the 3’ branch ligation adapter by combining 10 μL of BranchT (100 μM), 10 μL of BranchB (100 μM), and 10 μL of Annealing Buffer (3X) in the second well of the same PCR strip tube.
Incubate at 70 °C for 3 minutes.
Ramp temperature from 70 °C to 20 °C at a rate of 0.1 °C/s on a PCR thermocycler.
Couple the Tn5 enzyme to the transposon by combining 9.6 μL of hybridized capture transposon with 23.53 μL of Tn5 (13.6 pmol/μL) and 46.87 μL of Coupling Buffer (1X).
Incubate at 30 °C for 1 hour.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant and wash once with 500 μL of Low-Salt Wash Buffer.
Make adapter oligo digestion mix by combining 10 μL of TA Buffer (10X), 4.5 μL of Exonuclease I (20,000 U/mL), 1 μL of Exonuclease III (100,000 U/mL), and 74.5 μL of dH2O.
Remove wash buffer and add digestion mix to beads.
Vortex lightly to resuspend beads and incubate on the tube revolver for 10 minutes at 37 °C on “oscillating” mode.
Add 11 μL of 1% SDS and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant and wash once with 500 μL of Low-Salt Wash Buffer and once with 500 μL of NEB2 buffer (1X).
Make capture oligo digestion mix by combining 10 μL of NEB2 buffer (10X), 2 μL of UDG (5,000 U/mL), 3 μL of APE1 (10,000 U/mL), and 85 μL of dH2O.
Remove wash buffer and add digestion mix to beads.
Lightly vortex to resuspend beads and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads.
Remove supernatant and wash once with 500 μL of High-Salt Wash Buffer.
Wash once more with 500 μL of Low-Salt Wash Buffer \(1X).
Prepare SSB binding mix by combining 20 μL of SSB binding buffer \(1X) and 4 μL of ET SSB \(500 μg/mL).
Remove wash buffer and add SSB binding mix to beads.
Vortex lightly to resuspend beads.
Incubate on the tube revolver for 30 minutes at 37 °C on “oscillating” mode.

Prepare 3’ branch ligation mix by combining 33.4 μL of 3’ Branch Ligation Buffer \(3X), 18 μL of the 3’ branch ligation adapter \(16.7 μM) prepared in step 61, 2 μL of T4 DNA ligase \(2x106 units/mL), and 46.6 μL of dH2O.
Remove wash buffer and add ligation mix to beads.
Vortex lightly to resuspend beads.
Incubate on the tube revolver for 2 hours at 25 °C on “oscillating” mode.
Place on DynaMag™-2 Magnet for 2 minutes to collect beads onto the side of the tube.
Remove supernatant and wash once with 500 μL of High-Salt Wash Buffer.
Wash once more with 500 μL of PCR buffer \(1X).
Prepare PCR master mix by adding 150 μL of 2X PCR buffer, 4 μL of PCR Primer 1 \(100 μM), 4 μL of PCR primer 2 \(100 μM), 6 μL of PCR enzyme, and 136 μL of dH2O.
Remove wash buffer and add PCR master mix to beads.
Vortex lightly to resuspend beads.
Cycle PCR reaction with the following conditions:
95 C for 3 minutes.
95 C for 10 seconds.
58 C for 30 seconds.
